spans.s:
f. (-णा)
1 The Vīṇā, or Indian lute, a fretted instrument of the guitar kind, usually having seven wires or strings, and a large gourd at each end of the finger board; the extent of the instrument is two octaves: it is supposed to be the invention of NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and has many varieties, enumerated according to the number of strings, &c.
2 Lightning.
E.
वी to go, &c., Uṇādi aff. न, form irr.

m. (-ण्डः)
The neck of a Vīṇā or lute.
E.
वीणा a lute, and दण्ड a stick.

m. (-न्धः)
The tie of a lute or lower part of the tail piece, where the wires are fixed.
E.
वीणा the lute, and अनुवन्ध appendage, tie.

m. (-दः)
A player on the Vīṇā, a lutanist.
E.
वीणा a lute, and वाद who causes to speak or sound; also with कन added, वीणावादक.

m. (-स्यः)
NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and inventor of the Vīṇā or lute.
E.
वीणा, and आस्य the countenance.
